subscription.term1: 1. Subscription Plans & GST: Subscriptions are offered as Monthly (INR 250), Quarterly (INR 600), and Annual (INR 1,100) plans. Goods & Services Tax (GST @ 18% or as applicable under Indian tax regulations) is added at checkout.
subscription.term2: 2. Monthly Recurring Billing: If you enable the monthly recurring payment option, you authorize recurring monthly billing of INR 250 + applicable GST upon completion of your active billing cycle until cancelled. You may cancel recurring billing anytime prior to the next renewal date from Account Settings.
subscription.term3: 3. Financial Data Privacy & Non-Storage: No card numbers, CVV codes, UPI PINs/handles, PayPal passwords, or Net Banking credentials are saved, cached, or logged by the platform.
subscription.term4: 4. Access & Cancellation: Plan benefits activate immediately upon payment confirmation. Existing paid cycles remain active through the end of the purchased period even if recurring renewal is turned off.
